inspiration.observed_pattern: An INSERT ... SELECT loads a staging table from a joined source and uses ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE as a no-op to ignore already-seen unique keys while preserving the existing row.
inspiration.mysql_mariadb_translation: Rewritten as an independently authored contact-capture deduplication flow. A source table feeds a unique-email staging table through a LEFT JOIN and deterministic source ordering; a duplicate email exercises the no-op upsert path while a new email is inserted. The original application schema and rows are not copied.

fixture_notes: The existing staged email remains unchanged when the incoming source repeats its email, while the new email is inserted. Source rows are ordered by source_id so the duplicate decision is deterministic.
determinism_notes: All IDs, emails, names, and source ordering are fixed; no clocks, randomness, sleeps, or concurrent connections are used.
setup: CREATE TABLE staged_contacts (contact_id INT PRIMARY KEY, email VARCHAR(96) NOT NULL UNIQUE, display_name VARCHAR(48) NOT NULL, source_label VARCHAR(24) NOT NULL)
CREATE TABLE contact_import (source_id INT PRIMARY KEY, email VARCHAR(96) NOT NULL, display_name VARCHAR(48) NOT NULL, source_label VARCHAR(24) NOT NULL)
INSERT INTO contact_import VALUES (101, 'ada@example.test', 'Ada Incoming', 'nightly'), (102, 'lin@example.test', 'Lin New', 'nightly'), (103, 'unused@example.test', 'Unused', 'ignored')

steps.sql: INSERT INTO staged_contacts (contact_id, email, display_name, source_label) SELECT i.source_id, i.email, i.display_name, i.source_label FROM contact_import i LEFT JOIN staged_contacts s ON s.email = i.email WHERE i.source_id IN (101, 102) ORDER BY i.source_id DESC ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE contact_id = staged_contacts.contact_id, email = staged_contacts.email, display_name = staged_contacts.display_name, source_label = staged_contacts.source_label

checks.sql: SELECT contact_id, email, display_name, source_label FROM staged_contacts ORDER BY contact_id
SELECT COUNT(*) AS staged_count, COUNT(DISTINCT email) AS unique_emails FROM staged_contacts
